index.title: Make community health a shared effort
index.description: Support outreach, bring your skills or develop an institutional partnership.

paragraphs: Each pathway explains the proposed contribution and lets you try a local enquiry form.

items.title: Support community care
items.description: Explore ways to support the practical work behind outreach.

paragraphs: These steps describe the proposed process, not an accepted application or partnership.
There is no payment facility in this prototype. Do not enter bank, card or mobile-money details.

lists: Define the community need and programme scope.

lists: Clinical roles require appropriate credential verification before deployment.
Community and operational roles support education, logistics and access.
Orientation and role-specific supervision should precede field activity.
